resources.string: Amatipsi ari mu verisiyo ya Play Store

Gutangira vuba
1. Shyiramo Torque Pro (verisiyo yishyurwa; Torque Lite idashyigikira plugins) hanyuma uhuze adapter yawe ya OBD-II.
2. Fungura iyi plugin muri Torque → Igenamiterere → Plugins.
3. Emera imenyesha, kandi ushyire ikoreshwa rya batiri kuri Nta gipimo kugira ngo Torque ishobore gutangiza iyi plugin inyuma.
4. Muri Torque, hitamo profil y'imodoka y'imodoka uyobora. Amakuru abikwa kuri buri profil ya Torque kandi ageragezwa n'umwirondoro VIN/ECU w'imodoka.
5. Ku profil nshya, inkomoko y'amavuta imenywa iyo uhuza; niba ubajijwe, uyigereranye n'igipimo cyo ku kibaho hanyuma ukande Emeza. Emeza iri ku ipaji yo gushiraho no mu menyesha. Ushobora kandi kuyihitamo hepfo.
6. Ingano y'itanki ni ingano yo gutangiriraho y'guhuza Chunk kugeza yige iya yo. Plugin ntigira icyo ihindura; ingano buri guhuza kwize igaragara hepfo yayo.
7. Muri Torque, ongeraho ibipimo bya [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level n'ibya buri guhuza: Corrected %, Remaining, DTE na Tank size. DTE ni Remaining ikubye mpg y'igihe kirekire ya Torque. Itangazo mu gihe cyo kongera guhuza rivuga ko uko guhuza gusoma 1:1 kugeza kongera guhuza kurangira.
8. Subiza urwego rw'amavuta kuri Torque: Kuzimya, Kurambura, cyangwa Gukosora biva mu guhuza Chunk, Band cyangwa Kalman ku gipimo cyawe cya 012F.
9. Amavuta abarwa gusa igihe moteri ikora. Plugin ikora gusa igihe Torque ifatanyije na ECU.
10. Komeza kuyobora no kuzuza; ukuri kurushaho kuboneka ku matanki atuzuye menshi. Niba imenyesha Profil y'imodoka itari yo? igaragara, hitamo icyo ukora kuri urwo rugendo.
11. Amakuru yose aguma kuri iyi telefoni. Nta GPS cyangwa ahantu bifashwe.

Subiza urwego rw\'amavuta kuri Torque (yandika hejuru ya 012F)
Gutangira ku batiri cyangwa inyuma byanzwe. Fungura rimwe kugira ngo plugin ikore hamwe na Torque.

Ongeraho izindi tanki uko bikenewe (itanki ya ruganda 1 iguma). Ntuhure abatanga ku pin ya PCM FLI (kuzuza binyoma). Buri tanki y\'inyongera ikeneye PID y\'inyongera ya Torque (MCU Mode 22, izina ryihariye — si 012F cyangwa Ford 16C1). Agaciro ka Select-PID ni id y\'itanki itangirira kuri 1. Gal/hr ishyirwa ku tanki ikora gusa.
Ingano y\'itanki ni ingano yo gutangiriraho y\'guhuza Chunk kugeza yige iya yo. Plugin ntigira icyo ihindura; ingano buri guhuza kwize igaragara hepfo yayo.

Yandika agaciro ku Fuel Level isanzwe ya Torque (012F) kugira ngo ibipimo bisanzwe kibyerekane: Kuzimya, Kurambura, cyangwa Gukosora biva mu guhuza Chunk, Band cyangwa Kalman. Guhuza kutarabakwa gusa kwandika urwego rwarambuye.
Ikeneye Torque Pro (yishyurwa). Torque Lite idashyigikira plugins.
Kwandika birambuye (debug; imirongo ya log buri segonda)
Izina rya iyi profil y\'imodoka. Buri profil y\'imodoka ya Torque ibona profil ya plugin yayo, amakuru yayo n\'amakarita yize.
Ikirango cy\'imodoka (urugero Ford). Ikoreshwa gusa mu guhitamo PID z\'amavuta z\'ikirango kumenya gushobora kugerageza.

Urwego rw\'amavuta rudatunganyije ruva he. Menya (ECU igomba kuba ihujwe) igerageza abashoboka isoma gusa kandi ikagusaba kwemeza keretse inkomoko ebyiri bihuye. Emeza iri ku ipaji yo gushiraho no mu menyesha. Nta na kimwe = menya ku ihuzwa rikurikira.
Gusa ku nkomoko «PID y\'inyongera ya Torque ukurikije izina rirerire»: izina rirerire nyaryo rya PID ya Torque itanga urwego.
ubusa = nta ngano yo gutangiriraho; buri guhuza kwigira kwayo.
Igihe gihoraho cy\'akayunguruzo ko kurambura (0 = nta kurambura).
Ihunduka rinini buri segonda urwego rwarambuye rushobora gukurikira; kunyeganyega kurenze ibyo ntikibarwa.
Kuzamuka k\'urwego uri ahagaze kubarwa nk\'uzuza.
Bitari ngombwa: andika kilometero hanyuma Bika pin kugira ngo ushyireho intera ya iyi profil.
Itanki ishyirwaho gushya amavuta (gal/hr). Iva kuri PID: PID ya Torque iyitoranya (id y\'itanki itangirira kuri 1).
Gusa iyo Itanki ikora = Iva kuri PID: izina rirerire rya PID ya Torque ifite id y\'itanki nk\'agaciro.
Izina rirerire ryihariye ry\'itanki %1$d (urugero [FuelSmooth] Tank%1$d Level)
Nta na kimwe (Menya ikora iyo uhuza)
Itsinda rya Toyota 2129 (kubara igice cya litiro)

Fuel Smoothing nta nkomoko y\'urwego rw\'amavuta ifite ya %1$s. Fungura ipaji yo gushiraho ukande Menya, cyangwa hitamo inkomoko.
Nta rwego rw\'amavuta kuri uru rugendo
%1$s nta rwego rukoreshwa yatanzwe kuri %2$s. Suzuma ihuzwa ry\'adapter, cyangwa ukore Menya ku ipaji yo gushiraho.
Fungura igenamiterere rya Fuel Smoothing uhitemo inkomoko (cyangwa wongere PID muri Torque), hanyuma ukande Menya.
Hamenyekanye %1$s isoma %2$.0f %% kuri %3$s. Suzuma ko ihuye n\'igipimo cy\'amavuta ku kibaho, hanyuma ukande Emeza. Emeza iri ku ipaji yo gushiraho no mu menyesha (%4$s).

Iyi modoka ni %1$s (%2$s), ariko profil ya Torque ni \'%3$s\'. Amakuru ajya kuri %1$s; kanda ufungure Torque uhindure profil.
Profil ya Torque \'%1$s\' ihuye n\'iyi modoka (%2$s). Igitekerezo: %3$s. Amakuru abikwa kandi ajugunywa ku mpera y\'urugendo keretse uyabika.
Uru rugendo ruzabikwa muri %1$s. API ya plugin ya Torque ntishobora gukora cyangwa guhindura profil za Torque: muri Torque, kora cyangwa hitamo profil y\'imodoka yitwa \'%2$s\'.
